title: PACE-S cluster record
description: One explicit solvation cluster (Tier 0.5): a stoichiometry plus one placement variant (pose). Charge, multiplicity and formula are derived from the species by pace_s.solvation.species, never typed by hand. Distinct from molecules (PSM-), calculations (PCC-) and formulations (PACES-). Introduced in PACE-S 2.0; additive changes only.

protocol.description: Cluster family. isolated_* are the reference species of the reactions; *_sat give Li+ about four donor atoms (number of solvent molecules depends on the solvent).

composition_label.description: Deterministic key, e.g. 'Li+(1)FSI-(1)DME(1)'; the same label is used to look up energies in reactions.

molecule_id.description: Candidate-table id for solvents/diluents; null for Li+ and FSI-.

n_donor_atoms_offered.description: Donor atoms (O, amine N, thioether S) of the neutral ligands, by the heuristic in species.donor_atoms; the coordination actually reached is measured after optimization.

status.description: flagged_reactive: connectivity changed during optimization (decomposition, proton transfer, fragment loss); such clusters are never used as intact solvation minima.
